pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft-to-medium edge gradients and moderate crenulation. Patches are largest on the mid-flank and smaller/denser towards the rump.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned continuous pathways forming a topological web. Junction nodes are primarily tri-modal. Pathway width is greater on the neck than the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured serrated 1D profile against the sky. High-frequency hair clusters create a consistent jagged silhouette.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct thinning or gap in the mane line is observed at the base of the visible neck/shoulder transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A horizontal linear hypopigmented mark is visible on the mid-posterior flank. Faint vertical striations are present on the upper rump.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant shadowing from foreground foliage across the neck and anterior flank.
